page.overview:
What is Crown Tundra?

The Crown Tundra is a snow-swept realm in the Galar region that is featured in The Crown Tundra expansion. It is located south of Postwick and is home to many Pokémon. It is based on .

During the story, Galarian Articuno will be roaming across the Crown Tundra.
